form:FormGroup.label: Cluster configuration
form:FormGroup.helpText: Elasticsearch cluster document that holds the connection details for this index. Only clusters you have Use permission on are listed.

form:FormGroup.label: Index name or pattern
form:FormGroup.helpText: Name of the Elasticsearch index to search, or a pattern matching several indices or a data stream, e.g. events-*

form:FormGroup.label: Main date field
form:FormGroup.helpText: Name of the date field used to apply the query time range. Usually @timestamp, especially for data streams. If left blank, @timestamp is used.

form:FormGroup.label: Number of slices
form:FormGroup.helpText: Number of slices to query at the same time when retrieving search results. Increasing this can speed up retrieval from large indices. 1 to 1000. Default is 1.

valuespinner:ValueSpinner.title:
Number of concurrent threads to use to retrieve search results.
Increasing this value can speed up retrieval for larger indices.

form:FormGroup.label: Scroll size
form:FormGroup.helpText: Number of documents to retrieve in each scroll batch when searching. 1 to 1,000,000. Default is 1000.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Documents per batch, 1 to 1,000,000. Default is 1000.

valuespinner:ValueSpinner.title: How many results to retrieve each batch

form:FormGroup.label: Default extraction pipeline
form:FormGroup.helpText: Pipeline used to extract field values from the original events at search time, when a dashboard or query does not specify its own extraction pipeline.

form:FormGroup.label: Vector generation model
form:FormGroup.helpText: AI model used to create vector embeddings from query terms, so that dense_vector fields can be searched. Required to search dense_vector fields.

form:FormGroup.label: Rerank model
form:FormGroup.helpText: Optional AI model used to rerank vector search results by comparing each result's text with the search term. If left blank, results are not reranked.

form:FormGroup.label: Rerank text field suffix
form:FormGroup.helpText: Suffix of the text field that holds the original text for each dense_vector field. The vector field suffix is replaced with this, e.g. Content.vector becomes Content.text. Default is .text.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: E.g. Content.vector uses Content.text. Default is .text.

g:TextBox.title:
Suffix used to identify the text equivalent of dense_vector fields (e.g. `.text`).
The original text field value is obtained by removing the vector field suffix (e.g. `.vector`) and replacing it with the supplied suffix (e.g. `.text`).

form:FormGroup.label: Rerank score field suffix
form:FormGroup.helpText: Suffix used to name the field that receives the rerank score. The vector field suffix is replaced with this, e.g. Content.vector gives Content.score, which can be used in dashboard expressions. Default is .score.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: E.g. Content.vector gives Content.score. Default is .score.

g:TextBox.title:
Suffix used to name the destination rerank score field, after removing the vector field suffix (e.g. `.vector`) and replacing it with the supplied suffix.
This field is set to the relevance score when comparing the original text field against the user's search term.
This field can be referenced in dashboard expressions, e.g. $\{BaseField.score\}.

form:FormGroup.label: Minimum Rerank Score
form:FormGroup.helpText: Only results with a rerank score greater than or equal to this value are included. A number from 0.0 to 1.0. Default is 0.8. If above 0, the score field must be included in the query's fields.

g:TextBox.title: Only include results with a rerank score greater than or equal to this value (in the range 0.0 to 1.0)
